$comment: Block definitions of the built-in `dwell` namespace (docs/BLOCK_REGISTRY.md). Run `node shared/blocks/gen.mjs` after editing; CI fails if the generated files are stale. Blocks take runtime state ids in this order, each block's states in property order (keys alphabetical, the last key varying fastest, values in declared order). Air must come first (id 0). `fluids` are the named fluid looks (docs/BLOCK_REGISTRY.md, 'Fluid looks') that blocks with `"look": "fluid"` reference by name; a fluid block's opacity is its fluid's. The content is prototype (ARCHITECTURE.md §6.1).
$rampFamilies: Half-height grid (Phase 41, docs/HALF_HEIGHT_GRID.md): each listed natural block gets `<name>_ramp[facing, flooded, half, shape]`, the stored cardinal ramps the generator places (shape ramp, steep_lower, steep_upper). Natural blocks are not adaptive on this grid: shapes are chosen once, at generation. Their `flooded` (as on main) marks a block the sea's water stands in: a ramp below sea level holds it in its open part (WATER_RENDERING.md §9).
$lights: Light sources (docs/LIGHTS.md §2): the dynamic point lights that blocks reference by name (`light`), held in a hand or placed. color (sRGB), strength (its irradiance at the flame), radiusM (where it ends; a placed torch's block light reaches `emits` metres, so the same radius lights alike), flicker (amount: the share of its strength it takes at most; speed: its noise's cycles a second), shadows (whether it may cast them, the Torch shadows setting's, Phase 47 T2), flame (optional: the flame look drawn where it burns, a name in shared/look/flames.json; docs/LIGHTS.md §6). A placed block's flood light is its `emits`; a held one never touches the flood light.

blocks.name: dirt
blocks.$comment: sideUnder: a dirt side face with grass (or snowy grass) directly above (a slope's low side at a step or cliff) shows the turf's (or the snow's) skirt hanging over its top edge (docs/PAINTERLY_TEXTURES.md §2).

blocks.name: ladder
blocks.$comment: Drawn cutout: the ladder tile's gaps between rails and rungs are transparent. selectionBox: aimed at by its plate, ⅛ m against the wall it is mounted on (written for facing north and turned per facing), not the whole cell.

blocks.name: water
blocks.$fillProperty: How full the cell is, in eighths (docs/WATER_FLOW.md §15): a basin's top row is written at its level's fill, so water rises and falls smoothly; generated and placed water is full.
blocks.$lightFilter: Flood light (docs/DAY_NIGHT.md §11): each ½ m of water takes a level off the sky light under it.

blocks.$comment: The structure sandbox's ground (prototype, docs/STRUCTURES.md §7.6): white with a faint line at every block edge (the `grid` tile) and a stronger one every 8 blocks (the `grid` look option), not in the palette, and indestructible so it can always be built on. Not adaptive: it stays flat cubes.
blocks.name: sandbox_floor

blocks.$comment: A trunk or branch (docs/FELLING.md): a carrier, holding up the leaves on it while a path of logs reaches the ground, and falling when cut off. Its axis turns its end grain (top, bottom) to face along it, so a felled trunk lies along x or z.
blocks.name: log

blocks.$comment: Drawn cutout: the leaves tile has transparent gaps between the leaves. lightFilter: a canopy dims the sky light under it rather than shutting it out (docs/DAY_NIGHT.md §11). A rider (docs/FELLING.md): held up by the logs it belongs to, holding nothing; passable: players walk through it (owner, 2026-10-27). flooded (ADR 0063; owner, 2026-11-07: "underwater leaves z fighting, I think they should be flooded"): under water the leaves hold it in their gaps, drawn as the water beside them.
blocks.name: leaves

blocks.$comment: Prototype content (docs/TRANSPARENT_BLOCKS.md §6): blades of grass, the first plant. No collision; crossed quads drawn cutout, jittered per cell, swaying in the wind and fading out before the LOD; placed by hand only (world generation doesn't grow it), on grass or dirt, replaced by what is placed into it, and gone with the block under it.
blocks.name: tall_grass

blocks.$comment: The stored ramps (rampFamilies) at their own slots, as generated before the torch was added: blocks added after them keep every earlier state id (the worldgen goldens hash ids). Stone's are placeable: the hotbar's stone slopes (shared/items, owner 2026-10-30).
blocks.name: stone_ramp

blocks.$comment: Prototype content (docs/LIGHTS.md): a torch on the floor, 1 m tall over two ½ m cells. This is its lower cell (the stick), placed from the palette; `extends.up` puts `dwell:torch_upper` (the flame) in the cell above, and breaking either cell clears both (BLOCK_REGISTRY.md, Multi-cell blocks). Crossed quads, drawn cutout, no collision, standing on the block below and gone with it. Its `light` is the light a hand holding it gives off; a hand holding it shows the `torch` item (shared/characters).
blocks.name: torch

blocks.$comment: The torch's upper cell (docs/LIGHTS.md): the stick's top and the flame, which gives off the block light (`emits` 14, its cell the flame's) and, with Torch shadows (T2), the placed torch's dynamic light. Placed only with its torch (`partOf`).
blocks.name: torch_upper

blocks.$comment: The bedrock between the faces (docs/BIFACIAL_WORLD.md §2, owner 2026-10-21: "add bedrock back in between the two faces"): generated in the layers either side of the midplane (`shared/worldgen/terrain.json` `bedrock`), indestructible so no edit, region tool or brush cuts it; the faces meet only through the portals' shafts (`shared/worldgen/portals.json`). Not placeable.
blocks.name: bedrock

blocks.$comment: Snow lying on turf (owner, 2026-10-21: "add snow 'grass' block"): grass's counterpart on high ground, which the terrain generator tops columns with above the snow line (shared/worldgen/terrain.json `bands`). A white snow top, a side with the snow's fringe hanging over the dirt (the `hang` tile, as grass's turf), dirt below; dirt under it shows the fringe as its skirt (`sideUnder`). Its ramps are stored like grass's (`rampFamilies`).
blocks.name: snowy_grass

blocks.$comment: Leaves under snow (owner, 2026-10-21: "snow leaves"): the leaves' cutout canopy and light filter with snow on the top face and caught on the sides. Trees growing high up take it for their leaves (shared/worldgen/placements.json `variants`).
blocks.name: snowy_leaves

blocks.$comment: Prototype content (docs/BUILT_BODIES.md §3, owner 2026-11-02): the build platform. Placed, it starts a built body (shared/physics/bodies.json `startedBy`) instead of going in the world's grid: blocks placed against it join that body, which never settles back into the world.
blocks.name: build_platform

blocks.$comment: Water running between basins (docs/WATER_FLOW.md §15): a spill over a dam, a fall down the other side, a stream to where it lands. Drawn and swum as water (the same fluid); the water flow draws it while an outlet runs and takes it away when it stops, and treats it as open: no basin is found in it, and a basin rising fills over it. Named by flow.json's `running` for its liquid.
blocks.name: running_water

blocks.$comment: Prototype content (docs/EXPLOSIVES.md, owner 2026-11-06): dynamite, placed unlit. Place with a torch held, aimed at it, lights it (shared/explosives: it becomes dwell:lit_dynamite and its fuse runs). Caught in a blast it is lit with a short random fuse.
blocks.name: dynamite

blocks.$comment: Dynamite with its fuse burning (docs/EXPLOSIVES.md): only lighting makes it; nothing breaks or overwrites it (`indestructible`) until it blows. Its light is the sputtering fuse (`dwell:fuse`, a small flame on its top) and its sound set's `burn` the fizz.
blocks.name: lit_dynamite

blocks.$comment: Prototype content (docs/EXPLOSIVES.md §variants, owner 2026-11-06): blue dynamite, a 4 m blast that destroys everything in it and flings nothing (shared/explosives). Lit with a torch as red's.

blocks.$comment: Green dynamite with its fuse burning (as dwell:lit_dynamite).
